title: Adifi
tagline: This project is a decentralized finance (DeFi) monitoring agent built using the Warden Protocol Agent Kit. The tool is designed to continuously track real-time trading volume and liquidity metrics on Uniswap. Its primary purpose is to identify significant market moves
description:
Adifi: Its' AI-powered DeFi assistant analyzes Uniswap pools in real-time. It helps you to get smart trading recommendations with entry/exit points & risk assessment based on Uniswap pools through TheGraph and powered by Warden Protocol.
It was build using the AI Agent Warden kit so in the repo you must go to main/examples/typescript/cli-agent where the agent modified with Adifi Capabilities is located
how_its_made:
This project is built with React+Vite, Express.js backend, Claude 3 AI & LangChain. Integrates Uniswap data via Graph Protocol and uses Warden Protocol to manage the AI Agent logic.
The benefit of using Warden Protocol is that we can easily put the logic of an AI agent on a blockchain and TheGraph helped with obtaining the data in real-time easily thanks to the API key and subgraph that is already built in there.
